name: Helios-Nomad SynthShell All-Weather Modular Coat
description: A full-length weathershell coat in gunmetal grey with modular limb extensions — sleeve and hem panels clip on via industrial-grade fasteners to accommodate varying limb lengths across different chassis models. Thermal lining inserts are removable for summer use, and the collar seals magnetically against lake-effect wind. Inner lining pockets are positioned for non-human reach geometry. Underneath: a thermally bonded base layer tunic and legging in matte slate, sold as a bundle.
functionality: Modular clip-extension limb panels, removable thermal lining, magnetic collar seal for sub-zero lake-effect conditions.
what_it_says: I am built to survive this city's weather, whatever this city thinks of what I am.
worn_by: free synthetics in Shelf and Circuit zones
story_hooks: The coat's inner lining has been used to smuggle synthetic ID documents across checkpoints for three seasons.
A synthetic wearing this was caught in the lake-effect blizzard of '98 and survived forty hours exposed — the coat became a symbol.
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions ChemoShield BX-2 Dermal Toxin Barrier Implant
TESSERA CORPONATION Aegis CorpSec Hardened Security BCI

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, architectural full-length coat with a utilitarian silhouette that reads as both haute couture and hardened field gear. The gunmetal grey creates a neutral, professional presence that doesn't signal wealth or poverty—it signals *adaptation*. The coat has a columnar shape with pronounced shoulder seams and a slightly raised collar. Modular extension panels at sleeves and hem create visible articulation points, giving it an almost exoskeletal quality.
physical_description.fit: Tailored yet accommodating—fitted through the torso with enough ease in the shoulders for servo augmentation, looser in the limbs to accept variable-length extensions. The base layer tunic beneath is compression-cut, hugging synthetic or augmented bodies with equal precision.
physical_description.primary_material: Ballistic weave shell in gunmetal grey; thermally bonded synthetic-wool base layer in matte slate. The extensions use the same weatherproof composite as the coat body.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, slightly matte finish on the shell with micro-texture grip zones at the collar and cuff seams. Base layer has a subtle ribbed knit texture for thermal efficiency. Industrial-grade fastener points create small tactile nodes around limb attachment zones.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal grey primary with slate grey base layer. Minimal branding—small embossed Helios-Nomad logo at left chest. Metallic clip hardware in brushed steel provides subtle accent points.
physical_description.closures: Center-front magnetic seal running full length with subtle magnetic snap points at clavicle and hip. Modular sleeve and hem extensions use heavy-duty ball-bearing clips rated for servo loads. Collar has a secondary magnetic seal with micro-adjusters.
distinctive_features: Clip-on sleeve extensions for variable limb lengths
Removable thermal lining inserts that store in lower hip panels
Magnetic collar seal engineered for 80+ kph wind speeds
Internal pockets positioned for non-human arm geometry (higher, wider spacing)
Reinforced shoulder seam architecture to accept servo harness attachment points
Geo-stitching pattern that reduces wind drag vectors
Integrated cable routing channels along inner seams for medical or tech lines
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 crossover. Premium engineering signals corporate or high-functioning independent, but modular design and thermal efficiency suggest someone who *works* in harsh conditions rather than posing in them.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by field engineers, corporate security, autonomous vehicle pilots, medical nomads, and anyone with variable-length augmentation. Signals technical competence, environmental adaptation, and a body that isn't entirely standard.
physical_description.condition_typical: Crisp when new, but designed to patina gracefully. Typical wear shows micro-scuff marks at clip points, slight fading on shoulder seams, and minimal wrinkle retention due to synthetic composition.
